summary: Sagtec Global Limited filed a Form 6-K reporting a definitive private subscription agreement dated September 4, 2026 with HRH Prince Hassanal of Pahang for 850,000 Class A ordinary shares at US$0.65 per share, aggregate US$552,500, equal to roughly 5% of the company's ADS-equivalent equity. Closing is subject to board approval and Nasdaq compliance; payment is due within six months post-issuance. Proceeds fund working capital and expansion. This is a routine private placement, not a special situation; watch dilution, restricted Rule 144 status, and collection risk on the deferred subscription receivable.
